def fill_rule(inp, foreground, fill=2):
 g=inp.copy(); ln=defaultdict(list)
 for r,c in zip(*np.where(g==foreground)): ln[int(r+c)].append(int(r-c))

 for (d1,l1,h1),(d2,l2,h2) in zip(its,its[1:]):
  lo=max(l1,l2); hi=min(h1,h2)
  for d in range(d1+1,d2):
   for v in range(lo,hi+1):
    if (d+v)%2: continue
    r=(d+v)//2;c=(d-v)//2
    if 0<=r<g.shape[0] and 0<=c<g.shape[1] and g[r,c] not in (foreground,): g[r,c]=fill
